name: gap-over-promo
description: Cart holds the Jamdani Saree (৳1,950, gap ৳50 under the ৳2,000 free-delivery threshold) which ALSO has an active unapplied SAREE200 code (min_cart ৳1,500 met) — both delivery_gap and missed_discount offers qualify at once. Shopper bounces checkout -> cart (back_nav), the priority rule in prompts/decide.md says the delivery_gap card must win over the generic SAREE200 promo card (promo-code). Live finding 2026-09-12: SAREE200 fired first, the real gap card came ~45s late. Requires the real LLM loop — decide/stub.js has no promo/gap priority rule — so this fixture is NOT in check.sh's REQUIRED_STUB_FIXTURES list. `target` deliberately left unchecked here (was `shipping-banner`): with the anchor-fallback fix, a decide() call that happens to resolve while still on /checkout (this fixture's own /checkout page never lists shipping-banner as a target — only /cart does) correctly anchors delivery_gap to `cart-link` instead of failing closed; a call that resolves after the back_nav back to /cart still gets `shipping-banner` directly. Both are correct outcomes of the SAME priority decision — eyeball the trace's `decision`/`why` (should say `delivery_gap`, never `missed_discount`) to confirm the priority rule itself, not just the target.
